name: version-arm-linux
argv: set -ex; uname -a; c++ --version; ld --version; rustc --version --verbose; getconf GNU_LIBC_VERSION; sha256sum /usr/bin/g++ /usr/bin/ld /lib/*/libc.so.6 /usr/lib/*/libstdc++.so.6; dpkg-query -W libc6 libstdc++6
